01

Urban loop

An 8 km city route can include stairs, changing surfaces and easy transport options.

  • Choose legal pedestrian paths and safe crossings.
  • Include one climb or stair section if appropriate.
  • Set a turnaround point and identify alternatives.
02

Ridgeline challenge

A longer route with climbing needs more than an average pace estimate.

  • Check elevation, terrain and daylight.
  • Plan the pack around the weather and time outside.
  • Give yourself a genuine turnaround decision point.
03

Long-distance stage

Borrow a lesson from multi-day route planning: be ready to repeat the work tomorrow.

  • Set a realistic stage distance.
  • Plan water, food and foot-care stops.
  • Track time moving and time stopped.

The preview shows the supplied track, not a street map or turn-by-turn directions. Use the published map and current trail conditions for navigation. GPX files can contain private locations.
